answer: The protocol requires each AI agent to reserve 1 exclusive gateway slot, acting as a jetty for secure traffic that anchors its unique identity. An honest participant maintains this single reservation, whereas 1,000 fakes must pay an immense, non-linear infrastructure sum to hold parallel capacity across the network. A verifier monitors the black raven of session activity logs for occupancy overlaps; any confirmed breach triggers permanent account revocation. We verify this via a thin layer of shale logic, mapping connections to specific nodes.
